neighbours.label: Fires on 'known' in a reduced relative clause that introduces a name for the preceding noun ('a technique known as...', 'devices known as...'); quiet on 'known' as an adjective of fame ('well known for'), on 'have known someone', and on 'called' in the same naming slot.
fire: Doctors treated him with a therapy known as deep brain stimulation.
The farmers planted a hardy wheat variety known as Red Fife.
Ships avoided a stretch of water known as the Devil's Triangle.
Researchers studied a class of molecules known as prions.
The town hosts a festival known as the Night of Lanterns.
Bankers sold complicated bonds known as collateralized debt obligations.
Birds migrate along a route known as the East Atlantic Flyway.
The engineers built a structure known as a cofferdam.
quiet: Doctors treated him at a hospital well known for its heart surgeons.
The farmers have known the river for generations.
Ships avoided a stretch of water called the Devil's Triangle.
Researchers studied a class of molecules that nobody had seen before.
The town hosts a festival that is famous across the region.
Bankers sold complicated bonds that later lost their value.
Birds have long known the route over the eastern sea.
The engineers built a structure named after the mayor.
